messages:
Anya: Heads up — seeing a jump in hallucination_rate for redwood-7b-qlora-v3 (int8-nf4) on the 10% canary. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/runs/2038/cc1 :eyes:
Matt: link? which endpoint?
Anya: /chat/completions - started at 2038005600, spike aligns with yesterday's kernel switch to `kv-opt-v2`.
Sara: Was the canary using the new KV cache eviction?
Anya: yes, `kv-opt-v2` + int8-nf4 quant. latency improved slightly but quality dropped on our long-context summarization bench.
eval-bot: automated eval summary attached:
```
model: redwood-7b-qlora-v3
quant: int8-nf4
canary_pct: 10
metrics (prod vs baseline):
  hallucination_rate: baseline=0.032 -> canary=0.078  (+0.046 absolute, +144% relative)
  rouge_l (summaries): baseline=0.421 -> canary=0.410  (-0.011, -2.6%)
  p95_latency_ms: baseline=78 -> canary=74 (-5%)
  cost_per_1k_tokens: baseline=$3.12 -> canary=$2.48 (-20%)
```
Lee: Interesting — big jump in hallucination_rate but latency/cost improved. Could be quantization affecting beam scoring or tokenization alignment.
Matt: Any sign of dataset-specific regression? long-context vs short?
Anya: Mostly long-context (>2048) examples. Short responses look fine.
Sara: We shouldn't promote further. Suggest stop auto-increment, run targeted eval set (long-context QA + hallucination probes), and shadow traffic at 50% but not route user-visible traffic.
Matt: +1. Also capture KV-cache hit rates and topk probability distributions for tokens at cut boundaries.
Lee: For rollout policy: propose automatic fallback thresholds: any of the following should trigger immediate rollback OR switch to baseline model variant:
  - hallucination_rate absolute delta >= 0.03 AND relative increase >= 50%
  - rouge_l drop >= 2% absolute (or > 1.5% for key endpoints)
  - p95_latency degradation > 20% (but here it's improvement so ignore)
  - cost drop > 30% alone should not auto-fallback (we want cost wins)
Sara: also add an eval-set percentile-based guard: if 85th-percentile of per-example quality drops below baseline 85th-percentile by > 1.5 pts, trigger canary hold.
deploy-bot: canary advance requested by release pipeline -> from 10% to 25% at 2038005750
Anya: Please pause that advance. I'm rolling the canary back to 0% for /chat/completions until we run the targeted evals.
deploy-bot: canary rollback to baseline (redwood-7b-qlora-v2) initiated by @Anya at 2038005804 :white_check_mark:
Matt: After rollback, let's add the new automatic fallback rule to the canary controller: `auto_fallback_conditions: [hallucination_rate_delta, rouge_l_drop, percentile_guard]` and make it opt-in per-endpoint with default ON for summarization/QA.
Lee: I'll open a quick PR for the canary controller and add an integration test that simulates quantization-induced score shifts.
Sara: Assigning follow-up: `#task` run long-context hallucination harness, compare `v2` vs `v3-int8-nf4`, include beam scoring diffs and topk prob deltas.
Anya: Thanks — good catch by eval-bot. Let's be conservative on promotions for endpoints with long-context requirements. :lock:
Matt: +1 :thumbsup:
Anya: tagging @eng-sre to keep an eye on related infra changes (kv-opt-v2) while ML triages.
